title: pvPTSReader
body:
## pvPTSReader

Reads an ASCII PTS point cloud (.pts: point count, then x y z [intensity [r g b]] per line), as produced by laser scanners, into polydata with one vertex cell holding all points and Intensities and Color arrays when present. Optional limits subsample the file to a maximum number of points and/or keep only points inside a box. Use pvPDALReader for LAS/LAZ point clouds.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Scanner coordinates are often large georeferenced values; float storage can lose precision, so translate the cloud near the origin if fine detail matters.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so inspect the output blocks, arrays and time steps on your own files before relying on it.

Native constructor: `PTSReader`. Identity: `sources/PTSReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FileName` | This property specifies the file name for the PTS (ASCII Point Cloud) reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `LimitNumberOfPointsRead` | Limits the number of points read in from file | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `LimitPointCloudToBounds` | Restrict the point to cloud to a specified volume. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `MaxNumberOfPoints` | Specify the max number of point to be read. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `ReadBounds` | Define the spatial volume that will restrict the extent of the point cloud [xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax, zmin, zmax] | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":6,"minItems":6,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1,1,1,1]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvPTSReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
